name: b2m-react-shop
description: A small React 18 SPA + Express API with JWT auth, roles and history routing, used to test burp2model's crawler against a known route and API table.

scripts.start: mkdir -p public && cp node_modules/react/umd/react.production.min.js public/react.js && cp node_modules/react-dom/umd/react-dom.production.min.js public/react-dom.js && node server.js
